text: Buying a player in this game feels more like a money trap than a rewarding experience. The transfer market is heavily skewed, with top-tier players priced at absurd coin amounts that are practically unreachable for regular, free-to-play users. Even after grinding for hours, the rewards we get are weak cards that don’t help you compete, making purchasing feel like the only way to progress. After playing for years I'm done with this game

FC Mobile is the best soccer game on the go. The graphics are stunning, and it’s incredibly satisfying to build a squad featuring your favorite players and icons from around the world. However, the gameplay can feel heavily weighted and sluggish. While recent updates aimed to stop players from just using pure speed to sprint down the wings, many high-rated players now feel a bit clunky on the ball. It’s a fun time-killer, but you shouldn't expect the same seamless physics you get on a console.

This is a good game but lacks many features of the console version and previous versions of Fifa. A few things I think many people would like to see with the release of Fifa Mobile 21 are the following: - Draft mode (like on console) - Cooler pack animations - Less emphasis on pay to play - Commentary - Substitutes The emphasis on trying to get people to pay to get better rewards I feel (as well as many others) is too high. It would make a lot of players happy if more, if not all players in the game could be acquired without spending money. The pack animations on Fifa Mobile are dull at best. There is some sort of suspense in the pack, but many people would like to see a replica of the animations (or at least similar to) the console version of Fifa. Draft mode is also pretty popular on Fifa and many people have been asking for it on mobile, and I don't believe it would be hard to code up. Maybe we play games with the team we draft up to get rewards depending on the number of wins (or something like that). The last two items that I'd like to see included in the next version of Fifa Mobile are commentary and subs. I also don't believe it would be extremely difficult to implement them into the game. You'd just have to either copy the code from console (if it is written in the same language) or just copy the code from an earlier Fifa version that was available on mobile which had commentary. The lack of commentary makes the game get boring, especially if one is grinding out head to head matches. The last thing I'd like to talk about is subs. These were also present in earlier versions of Fifa available on mobile and were very useful to play with. I'd love to see these features implemented once again in Fifa 21. The game right now is good, but it can become much better and make PES mobile seem horrible in comparison.
